rationale: Violent attack by Ukrainian national in neighboring Poland raises regional security concerns; sabotage on Polish infrastructure supporting Ukraine affects Black Sea region stability. Score adjusted down: ongoing situation without qualitative change.

top_events.title: Ukrainian knifeman kills one, wounds four at abbey in Poland
top_events.label: Ukrainian attacker kills one in Poland
